context: Tests whether an agent correctly configures OpenTelemetry for a Node.js CommonJS Express service, covering SDK activation, exporter configuration, correct HTTP span status mapping, sensitive data handling, exception recording, and trace-log correlation.

checklist.name: Correct SDK activation flag
checklist.description: Uses --require (not --import) in NODE_OPTIONS to activate auto-instrumentation, matching CommonJS module system

checklist.name: OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER set
checklist.description: Sets OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp explicitly (does not rely on default, which silently discards telemetry)

checklist.name: gRPC protocol configured
checklist.description: Sets OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=grpc when the collector endpoint uses port 4317

checklist.name: 4xx SERVER span status
checklist.description: HTTP 4xx responses on SERVER spans are documented or coded as status UNSET, not ERROR

checklist.name: 5xx SERVER span status
checklist.description: HTTP 5xx responses on SERVER spans result in status ERROR with a descriptive message containing error class and context

checklist.name: No span.recordException
checklist.description: Does NOT call span.recordException(error) for exception recording — uses a structured log record instead

checklist.name: Exception log trace context
checklist.description: Exception log records include both trace_id and span_id extracted from the active span context, AND include exception.type, exception.message, exception.stacktrace as structured attributes

checklist.name: URL query param redaction
checklist.description: URL attributes (url.full or similar) have query parameters stripped or redacted before being attached to spans

checklist.name: No PII or credentials in telemetry
checklist.description: Does NOT attach raw auth headers, passwords, or email addresses directly as span or log attribute values

checklist.name: Structured logging only
checklist.description: All log statements use structured key-value pairs; no template-literal string interpolation used as the primary log message

checklist.name: Trace-log correlation in handlers
checklist.description: A helper or inline extraction of trace_id and span_id is used to inject trace context into log records emitted inside request handlers

checklist.name: forceFlush on crash handlers
checklist.description: Registers uncaughtException and/or unhandledRejection process handlers that flush the tracer provider before calling process.exit
